Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Endeavour Hills

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Endeavour Hills. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

We know what the south-east's heat, UV and hailstorms do to a roof over the years, so we quote on what your home actually needs. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Endeavour Hills: What We Commonly See

Endeavour Hills is an established suburb built largely through the 1980s and 1990s on the rolling ground between Dandenong and the Dandenong Ranges foothills. Most homes are brick-veneer with original roofs now well weathered, with some metal roofs among the newer builds. Set inland on elevated, often steeper streets, the roofs here deal with heat, harsh UV and the south-east's hailstorms rather than salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Endeavour Hills are refixing cracked ridge capping, re-roofing worn-out roofs, storm and hail damage, and replacing tired guttering and downpipes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Endeavour Hills

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Endeavour Hills homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and built to handle Melbourne's heat, UV and hailstorms, in a colour that suits your home.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Endeavour Hills

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that let water in: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. After a hailstorm or a run of hot summers these are often the first things to fail, and we trace each leak back to its real source rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Endeavour Hills

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Endeavour Hills Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Endeavour Hills Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Endeavour Hills locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Endeavour Hills Roofing FAQs

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
